hero.headline: I build e-commerce front-ends and connect them to the APIs behind them.
hero.summary: Almost five years at Linx with Vue.js and JavaScript, integrating search, personalized product showcases and ads into the websites of large retailers in Brazil.
hero.availability: Open to on-site or hybrid roles around Turin, Alessandria and Milan, remote roles, and relocation for the right position.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I grew up around computers: my father was a COBOL programmer and ran one of the first internet providers in Rio Grande do Sul. I joined my first programming class weeks late, learned the basics alone at home and scored full marks on the first test. The teacher thought I had copied, sat me alone for the next one, and I scored full marks again.

I still work the same way: I start from the real problem, solve it with the least code it needs, and keep it simple enough for anyone on the team to read. That is how I grew from junior to mid-level in almost five years at Linx.

I moved to Italy to be close to my family, where I live with an EU long-term residence permit, and kept working remotely. In 2026 I left Linx to settle here and learn Italian properly. Now I am back to building, and looking for a team where I can be useful and keep learning.
about.education: IT Technician, University of Santa Cruz do Sul (UNISC), 2015 – 2016

highlights: Built front-end features in Vue.js and JavaScript for search and personalized product showcases embedded in the websites of large e-commerce retailers in Brazil.
Integrated the Ads product into client websites while Ads was being migrated into the Impulse platform.
Wrote developer documentation in Swagger for the Ads APIs and the metadata SDK.
Checked metrics in MongoDB and debugged API calls with the browser network tools to make sure the data was correct.
The only front-end developer with write access to the central product-catalog parser, where I made changes.
Webhooks in JavaScript, code review, and CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Docker.
Websites for small and medium businesses in JavaScript, HTML and CSS, including a passenger transport company and an outdoor advertising company.
PHP contact form sending email over SMTP, so quote requests arrived from the site.
Startup scripts for thin clients in an accounting office: the management software opens automatically, admin access protected by password.
IT support and consulting for Linux, Windows Server and company networks.
National marketplace for outdoor advertising (OOH) spaces: search by region and contact with sellers. Firebird data with multi-JOIN SQL queries and stored procedures.
Google Maps API integration: markers and a heat map showing the number of spots on hover.
Course sales site for a training institute, with a SOAP integration to the Brazilian postal service (Correios) web service for shipping options (PHP, MySQL).
Maintenance of a legacy ASP.NET (ASPX) e-commerce with table-based layout and some PHP.

virgit.title: VirgIT · lesson platform
virgit.description: Web app built for a private Italian teacher and her students: a lesson calendar with drag-and-drop rescheduling and recurring lessons, lesson requests limited by her availability rules, student invites, homework with corrections, private materials, chat, in-app notifications and vocabulary review with spaced repetition. It also has an AI assistant, by text or voice, that answers her questions using the site documentation and can carry out tasks such as adding a student or sending homework.

hubLife.title: Hub Life · personal life dashboard
hubLife.description: The app I use every day to run my routine. It syncs steps, water and sleep from my smartwatch (Samsung Health) and weight from a smart scale, then updates my daily targets. The Gemini API estimates calories and macros from meal photos and turns voice messages into entries, including monthly expenses in euros and reais. Supabase keeps only the last 90 days; older data is archived as files in a GitHub repository.

portfolio.title: This portfolio
portfolio.description: Single-page site in Vue 3 and TypeScript, translated into English, Italian and Portuguese with vue-i18n. The repository list below is loaded live from the GitHub REST API. Built and deployed to GitHub Pages by GitHub Actions.

linxChallenge.description: Hiring challenge from Linx: a responsive product showcase in plain JavaScript, HTML and CSS that loads products from a paginated REST API and keeps the extra results in memory to avoid unnecessary requests. The original demo is no longer online.

items.title: Integration first
items.text: Most of my career was making a product work inside someone else's website. I start from the API contract and the browser network tab.

items.title: Learning by building
items.text: I am building a 2D RPG in Unity and C#, a field that was new to me, to keep learning new tools quickly.

items.title: Reviewed, tested, explained
items.text: I use documentation, browser dev tools and AI assistants to research and debug faster. I review and test everything, and only ship code I can explain.
